Two series of short videos about amorem. Every number on screen is computed
by running the package; the narration is in English.

## Night Sky Atlas

One real dataset per card, seen as a night sky: actors are stars, each event is
a streak of light between two of them, and time runs along the horizon. Each
card ends on one finding computed with amorem. The cards stand alone and can be
watched in any order.

```{=html}
<div class="sky-grid">
<div class="sky-card">
<video src="../videos/sky-01-washington.mp4" poster="../videos/sky-01-washington-poster.jpg" controls playsinline preload="none" aria-label="Night Sky Atlas No. 1: Over Washington"></video>
<p class="vid-n">No. 1</p>
<p class="vid-title">Over Washington</p>
<p class="vid-idea">Every leader-to-leader visit of the United States, 1945–2019. A country whose leader has just visited Washington is about twice as likely to be the president's next stop (2.08 times the rate, 95% interval 1.60 to 2.69).</p>
<p class="vid-idea">Try it in R: <code>amorem::us_leader_visits</code></p>
</div>
<div class="sky-card">
<video src="../videos/sky-02-classroom.mp4" poster="../videos/sky-02-classroom-poster.jpg" controls playsinline preload="none" aria-label="Night Sky Atlas No. 2: Over a Classroom"></video>
<p class="vid-n">No. 2</p>
<p class="vid-title">Over a Classroom</p>
<p class="vid-idea">One 44-minute US high-school class period, 16 October 1996: 20 people and 511 turns of talk. A turn back to someone who spoke to you in the last minute comes at 9.69 times the rate of an otherwise similar pair where that did not happen (95% interval 7.95 to 11.83).</p>
<p class="vid-idea">Try it in R: <code>amorem::classroom_events</code></p>
</div>
<div class="sky-card">
<video src="../videos/sky-03-football.mp4" poster="../videos/sky-03-football-poster.jpg" controls playsinline preload="none" aria-label="Night Sky Atlas No. 3: Over the football world"></video>
<p class="vid-n">No. 3</p>
<p class="vid-title">Over the football world</p>
<p class="vid-idea">Men&#x27;s international football, 1872 to 2026: 49,945 matches between 337 teams. A pair that met a year ago plays again at 2.3 times the rate of a pair that last met ten years ago (95% interval 2.2 to 2.5).</p>
<p class="vid-idea">Try it in R: <code>amorem::football_results</code></p>
</div>
<div class="sky-card">
<video src="../videos/sky-04-europe-lockdown.mp4" poster="../videos/sky-04-europe-lockdown-poster.jpg" controls playsinline preload="none" aria-label="Night Sky Atlas No. 4: Over Europe"></video>
<p class="vid-n">No. 4</p>
<p class="vid-title">Over Europe</p>
<p class="vid-idea">18,703 flights the OpenSky Network recorded between 60 European airports in April 2020. A route flown the other way in the last 12 hours carries the next flight at 3.83 times the rate of one flown the other way only earlier (95% interval 3.64 to 4.03).</p>
<p class="vid-idea">Data: OpenSky Network, CC BY 4.0</p>
</div>
<div class="sky-card">
<video src="../videos/sky-05-the-office.mp4" poster="../videos/sky-05-the-office-poster.jpg" controls playsinline preload="none" aria-label="Night Sky Atlas No. 5: Over the Office"></video>
<p class="vid-n">No. 5</p>
<p class="vid-title">Over the Office</p>
<p class="vid-idea">The first 60 days of e-mail in a manufacturing company in Poland, 2010: 14,962 e-mails among 167 employees. Copies flow to someone who has already written to the sender at 7.04 times the rate of a pair where they have not (95% interval 5.61 to 8.82).</p>
<p class="vid-idea">Try it in R: <code>amorem::radoslaw_email</code></p>
</div>
<div class="sky-card">
<video src="../videos/sky-06-rome.mp4" poster="../videos/sky-06-rome-poster.jpg" controls playsinline preload="none" aria-label="Night Sky Atlas No. 6: Over Rome"></video>
<p class="vid-n">No. 6</p>
<p class="vid-title">Over Rome</p>
<p class="vid-idea">Italy's diplomatic visits, 2000–2023. Next to come to Rome: a country Italy had visited two times since 2000 comes at 2.02 times the rate of one it had not visited (95% interval 1.78 to 2.28).</p>
<p class="vid-idea">Data: Corda &amp; Casiraghi, Italy's Diplomatic Visits, CC BY 4.0</p>
</div>
<div class="sky-card">
<video src="../videos/sky-07-copenhagen.mp4" poster="../videos/sky-07-copenhagen-poster.jpg" controls playsinline preload="none" aria-label="Night Sky Atlas No. 7: Over Copenhagen"></video>
<p class="vid-n">No. 7</p>
<p class="vid-title">Over Copenhagen</p>
<p class="vid-idea">28 days of calls and texts among 608 students of the Technical University of Denmark. 20.9% of all calls (754 of 3,600) go back to someone who called the caller in the hour before.</p>
<p class="vid-idea">Try it in R: <code>amorem::copenhagen_calls</code></p>
</div>
<div class="sky-card">
<video src="../videos/sky-08-invasions.mp4" poster="../videos/sky-08-invasions-poster.jpg" controls playsinline preload="none" aria-label="Night Sky Atlas No. 8: Over the Earth"></video>
<p class="vid-n">No. 8</p>
<p class="vid-title">Over the Earth</p>
<p class="vid-idea">11,730 first records of alien species in 259 regions of the world, 1880 to 2005. A species already in 4 regions reaches its next region at 1.97 times the rate of a species in 1 (95% interval 1.76 to 2.20).</p>
<p class="vid-idea">Try it in R: <code>amorem::alien_invasions</code></p>
</div>
<div class="sky-card">
<video src="../videos/sky-09-congress.mp4" poster="../videos/sky-09-congress-poster.jpg" controls playsinline preload="none" aria-label="Night Sky Atlas No. 9: Over Capitol Hill"></video>
<p class="vid-n">No. 9</p>
<p class="vid-title">Over Capitol Hill</p>
<p class="vid-idea">Every bill of the 118th US Congress, 2023 to 2025: 16,213 bills and 162,424 cosponsor signatures. 21.7% of the signatures cross party lines (35,300 of 162,424): 20.4% in the House, 28.2% in the Senate.</p>
<p class="vid-idea">Try it in R: <code>amorem::congress_bills_118</code></p>
</div>
<div class="sky-card">
<video src="../videos/sky-10-london-bikes.mp4" poster="../videos/sky-10-london-bikes-poster.jpg" controls playsinline preload="none" aria-label="Night Sky Atlas No. 10: Over London"></video>
<p class="vid-n">No. 10</p>
<p class="vid-title">Over London</p>
<p class="vid-idea">19,120 bike journeys between London&#x27;s 60 busiest docking stations, February 2026. Riding back along a journey made in the last 12 hours comes at 2.42 times the rate of riding back along one made only earlier (95% interval 2.31 to 2.54).</p>
<p class="vid-idea">Data: TfL cycle hire journeys, February 2026. Powered by TfL Open Data.</p>
</div>
<div class="sky-card">
<video src="../videos/sky-11-lichess.mp4" poster="../videos/sky-11-lichess-poster.jpg" controls playsinline preload="none" aria-label="Night Sky Atlas No. 11: Over Lichess"></video>
<p class="vid-n">No. 11</p>
<p class="vid-title">Over Lichess</p>
<p class="vid-idea">7,025 rated games between the 60 most active Lichess players, January 2013. A pair that met in the last hour is more than ten times as likely to play next as one that met only earlier (seed 1: 17, 95% interval 12 to 24; five random draws: 14 to 21).</p>
<p class="vid-idea">Data: Lichess open database, CC0</p>
</div>
<div class="sky-card">
<video src="../videos/sky-12-africa.mp4" poster="../videos/sky-12-africa-poster.jpg" controls playsinline preload="none" aria-label="Night Sky Atlas No. 12: Over Africa"></video>
<p class="vid-n">No. 12</p>
<p class="vid-title">Over Africa</p>
<p class="vid-idea">2,959 foreign-minister visits between 170 countries, reported by 30 African ministries, 2010 to 2022. A minister whose counterpart came in the past year visits back next at 1.38 times the rate (95% interval 1.19 to 1.59).</p>
<p class="vid-idea">Data: Burman Roy et al., CC BY 4.0</p>
</div>
</div>
```

## Time, Rate, History

Eleven short lectures that build relational event models from the ground up:
events, rates, history as a covariate, the partial likelihood, case-control
sampling, smooth effects, goodness of fit and global covariates. They are meant
to be watched in order.

```{=html}
<div class="sky-grid">
<div class="sky-card">
<video src="../videos/amorem-01-events-not-networks.mp4" poster="../videos/amorem-01-events-not-networks-poster.jpg" controls playsinline preload="none" aria-label="Time, Rate, History, episode 1: The data are events, not a network"></video>
<p class="vid-n">Episode 1</p>
<p class="vid-title">The data are events, not a network</p>
<p class="vid-idea">A relational event model starts from a log: who acted towards whom, and when.</p>
</div>
<div class="sky-card">
<video src="../videos/amorem-02-every-pair-has-a-clock.mp4" poster="../videos/amorem-02-every-pair-has-a-clock-poster.jpg" controls playsinline preload="none" aria-label="Time, Rate, History, episode 2: Every pair has a clock"></video>
<p class="vid-n">Episode 2</p>
<p class="vid-title">Every pair has a clock</p>
<p class="vid-idea">Give every ordered pair its own exponential clock.</p>
</div>
<div class="sky-card">
<video src="../videos/amorem-03-coefficients-multiply-rates.mp4" poster="../videos/amorem-03-coefficients-multiply-rates-poster.jpg" controls playsinline preload="none" aria-label="Time, Rate, History, episode 3: Coefficients multiply rates"></video>
<p class="vid-n">Episode 3</p>
<p class="vid-title">Coefficients multiply rates</p>
<p class="vid-idea">Each pair&#x27;s rate is a baseline times exp(beta times x).</p>
</div>
<div class="sky-card">
<video src="../videos/amorem-04-history-becomes-a-covariate.mp4" poster="../videos/amorem-04-history-becomes-a-covariate-poster.jpg" controls playsinline preload="none" aria-label="Time, Rate, History, episode 4: History becomes a covariate"></video>
<p class="vid-n">Episode 4</p>
<p class="vid-title">History becomes a covariate</p>
<p class="vid-idea">Endogenous statistics turn a log&#x27;s own past into covariates: reciprocity, transitivity, recency and their variants.</p>
</div>
<div class="sky-card">
<video src="../videos/amorem-05-which-dyad-fired.mp4" poster="../videos/amorem-05-which-dyad-fired-poster.jpg" controls playsinline preload="none" aria-label="Time, Rate, History, episode 5: Which dyad fired?"></video>
<p class="vid-n">Episode 5</p>
<p class="vid-title">Which dyad fired?</p>
<p class="vid-idea">Given that an event happened, which pair was it? The partial likelihood asks only that question.</p>
</div>
<div class="sky-card">
<video src="../videos/amorem-06-a-few-who-did-not.mp4" poster="../videos/amorem-06-a-few-who-did-not-poster.jpg" controls playsinline preload="none" aria-label="Time, Rate, History, episode 6: Compare with a few who did not"></video>
<p class="vid-n">Episode 6</p>
<p class="vid-title">Compare with a few who did not</p>
<p class="vid-idea">The partial likelihood sums over every pair at risk.</p>
</div>
<div class="sky-card">
<video src="../videos/amorem-07-how-many-controls.mp4" poster="../videos/amorem-07-how-many-controls-poster.jpg" controls playsinline preload="none" aria-label="Time, Rate, History, episode 7: How many controls?"></video>
<p class="vid-n">Episode 7</p>
<p class="vid-title">How many controls?</p>
<p class="vid-idea">How many non-events should be sampled per event? On a fixed history, more controls narrow the spread of the estimate without moving its centre: from one control to ten, the spread falls about three times.</p>
</div>
<div class="sky-card">
<video src="../videos/amorem-08-ghosts-do-not-write.mp4" poster="../videos/amorem-08-ghosts-do-not-write-poster.jpg" controls playsinline preload="none" aria-label="Time, Rate, History, episode 8: Ghosts read the past but never write it"></video>
<p class="vid-n">Episode 8</p>
<p class="vid-title">Ghosts read the past but never write it</p>
<p class="vid-idea">A sampled non-event did not happen, so it must read the history to get its covariates but must never write into it.</p>
</div>
<div class="sky-card">
<video src="../videos/amorem-09-shapes-not-slopes.mp4" poster="../videos/amorem-09-shapes-not-slopes-poster.jpg" controls playsinline preload="none" aria-label="Time, Rate, History, episode 9: With one control, a regression on differences"></video>
<p class="vid-n">Episode 9</p>
<p class="vid-title">With one control, a regression on differences</p>
<p class="vid-idea">With one control per event, the conditional logit becomes a logistic regression without intercept on case-minus-control differences.</p>
</div>
<div class="sky-card">
<video src="../videos/amorem-10-is-the-model-wrong.mp4" poster="../videos/amorem-10-is-the-model-wrong-poster.jpg" controls playsinline preload="none" aria-label="Time, Rate, History, episode 10: Is the model wrong?"></video>
<p class="vid-n">Episode 10</p>
<p class="vid-title">Is the model wrong?</p>
<p class="vid-idea">Rank the candidate models by AIC on one shared case-control sample, then check the winner.</p>
</div>
<div class="sky-card">
<video src="../videos/amorem-11-when-the-weekday-cancels.mp4" poster="../videos/amorem-11-when-the-weekday-cancels-poster.jpg" controls playsinline preload="none" aria-label="Time, Rate, History, episode 11: Why the weekday cancels"></video>
<p class="vid-n">Episode 11</p>
<p class="vid-title">Why the weekday cancels</p>
<p class="vid-idea">A covariate shared by every pair at the same moment, such as the weekday or El Nino, takes the same value for an event and its controls, so it cancels like the baseline.</p>
</div>
</div>
```
